patterns.note: Sections frequently use an asymmetrical two-column layout, often pairing a large visual (image or video) with a concise text block and call-to-action, alternating sides down the page.
Headings are set in a very large, bold, sans-serif typeface, often in all caps, creating a strong visual hierarchy and energetic tone.

A vibrant, energetic orange is the dominant brand color, used extensively for hero backgrounds, section dividers, and call-to-action buttons, creating a high-contrast and dynamic feel against white and dark grey backgrounds.

The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid orange background as it sticks to the top of the viewport. Content sections also reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport.

The site uses a recurring 'journey' or 'get started' section pattern, typically featuring three distinct options presented as cards with images, titles, and brief descriptions, encouraging user engagement.

technique_notes: The hero section features an auto-playing video that provides dynamic visual context for the product, enhancing engagement immediately upon page load.

The global navigation bar is initially transparent and full-height, then uses a CSS transition to shrink in height and adopt a solid background color as the user scrolls down the page, maintaining visibility and brand presence.

Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation (likely css-keyframes), where elements fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible in the viewport, adding a sense of dynamism to the content flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong impact, complemented by smaller uppercase labels and clear, readable body text for a balanced hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and cards feature a slight, consistent corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around elements and sections, with clear visual separation between content blocks).

standout: The site's standout design is its bold and immersive use of a high-energy orange color palette, which, combined with dynamic video content and clear, action-oriented typography, creates a highly motivating and engaging experience that immediately conveys the fun and excitement of indoor cycling.
